title: UN Climate Summit Concludes With Landmark Renewable Energy Finance Deal
content:
GENEVA — Delegates from more than 140 nations agreed to an unprecedented $300 billion annual climate resilience framework during the closing session of the United Nations Climate Conference early Monday morning.

The agreement, forged after two weeks of contentious overnight negotiations, establishes binding targets for transitioning emerging economies away from coal infrastructure while scaling grid battery storage.

UN Secretary-General António Guterres hailed the accord as a critical turning point, remarking: 'The world has demonstrated that global consensus on green energy transition is not only possible, but imperative for our collective survival.' Implementation is slated to begin in January under the supervision of international multilateral monitoring agencies.
